The Code of Criminal Procedure is not available in English. The attached English resources, prepared by Iran Human Rights Documentation Center, describe changes to successive versions of the Code following its initial 2013 approval by the Majles. 

English text of Book II of a previous 1999 version of the Code is available in the ABC library here.
